{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''High Plains Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000200155/000106610709000014/cig200810k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Cheyenne Hub, Colorado to Fort St. Vrain generating station, Colorado.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000200155/000106610709000014/cig200810k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''WYCO Development LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000200155/000106610709000014/cig200810k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''900 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=61095|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''164 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000200155/000106610709000014/cig200810k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=61095|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24, 30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000200155/000106610709000014/cig200810k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=61095|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000200155/000106610709000014/cig200810k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2008<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000200155/000106610709000014/cig200810k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$216,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
